title: runtime: pin that a disabled host package no longer hides a package-less stored row of a type stored per (package, name)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Source: contract review r2 6845067990 on PR #33006 (card #32812), should-fix S4.

#33006 declares one widening under its BREAKING banner: on a host that declares its package, a package-less stored row of the ten types stored per `(package, name)` is no longer hidden when the host's own package is disabled. It now behaves as it does on a host that declares no package. #33006 pins the cause in `@objectstack/metadata` (the served row carries no `_packageId`), but no package pins the answer itself.

Task: add a pin next to the reader in `@objectstack/runtime` (the disabled-package filter in `src/domains/meta.ts`). Do the same in `@objectstack/core` if its reader can be reached in a unit test. The pin should cover both hosts (declaring the package, declaring none) and expect the same answer on each. Tests only, no source change.

- **Size:** S.
- **Effort:** medium.
- **Blocked on:** #33006 landing. Do not start until it lands.
